title: pg-backup.json
description: One PostgreSQL database's backups: where it runs, where its archive is, what to stop while a restore goes back, and what a restore must contain.

server.description: The k3s server, reached as root over ssh.

namespace.description: The namespace the database runs in. Scratch restores go into <namespace>-restore-<time>.

statefulset.description: The database's StatefulSet; its pod is <statefulset>-0.

wal.description: The write-ahead log archive (terraform/wal-archive) and its keys.

secret.description: The Kubernetes Secret with gcs-key.json and libsodium-key.

bucket.description: The Cloud Storage bucket, without gs://.

gcs_key_secret.description: The Bitwarden secret holding the account's key.

encryption_key_secret.description: The Bitwarden secret holding WAL-G's libsodium key. Losing it makes the archive unreadable.

dump.description: The nightly logical dump, which promote runs once more before it changes anything.

app.description: What uses the database, stopped while promote replaces it.

selector.description: Its pods' label selector, such as app=keycloak.

check.description: What a restore must contain. query returns one row per thing, its name first and a count after a space; every name in required must be among them.
